_README: Cascade publishes CLS-* class wave cards here (schema: docs/audit/wave-queue.SCHEMA.json). Legacy per-module rows in AUDIT-COVERAGE-LIVE.md are WORM history and are NOT rewritten by this artifact. Cursor drains mechanical cards; Claude Coder drains money cards. verify-wave-card-format + verify-no-false-green-certify enforce the method in CI.

waves.root_cause: expense_category_account_map incomplete, posting_side incoherent, OR spend miscategorized into the wrong GL expense account (e.g. tires/tolls into Fuel). A TMS-native bill whose category code has no map row fails with BILL_LINE_ACCOUNT_UNRESOLVED / CATEGORY_MAPPING_MISSING; a scope-mismatched Fuel GL overage that is NOT a double-post is usually this class.
